title: Design: an Inactive matrix page and badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's row shows a gray Inactive badge and a dash for Categories, as in picture 3.9.

Step 2:

  • Beside the title, small gray text reads "Inactive: No categories use this matrix"; no badge shows on the page.
  • The Categories line reads None, as in picture 3.10.
